issues.testCaseTitle: Verify that non-PV organizations can use Spectacle Lens Add-Ons category search
issues.message: Expected result wording is vague; make it measurable.

analysis.jiraIssueSummary: 374. BE - Catalog Import - Spectacle Lens Add-Ons Product Category and Filters (Category, Add-On Name)
requirementOrBugAnalysis: Story scope is backend for Catalog Import support of a new Product Category option: "Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons".

Availability rule stated: Spectacle Lens category in catalog import is available only for non-PV organizations, and catalog import is not available for PV organizations for other categories as well. This implies this new category should also follow non-PV-only availability constraints.
When "Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons" is selected, add-on-specific filters must be shown and used for search/import flow.

Filter definitions include Supplier, Category, and Add-On Name with explicit UI behaviors documented (searchable fields, select behavior, sorting/defaults, clear behavior). Although this is BE story, FE-linked stories indicate contract/API behavior must support these constraints consistently.
Supplier filter is described as searchable single select DDM infinite scroll, with values: default "All" first, then active loaded supplier locations sorted A-Z; if none loaded then only "All".
Supplier sourcing rule: loaded eyeglasses active supplier locations across organization locations regardless of currently selected context location; electronic supplier locations only.
Supplier selection behavior for retrieval: All => master catalog; selected loaded suppliers => corresponding supplier catalogs.
Category filter is multi-select infinite scroll with values Coatings, Finishing, Other, Surfacing, Tints sorted A-Z.
Add-On Name filter is searchable text with max 200 characters and no minimum characters in main description; comments introduce possible 1-character typeahead behavior for search bar.

Multi-select behavior requirement applies to multi-select filters: keep dropdown open while selecting, explicit outside click to close, one in-field X clears all selected values, individual deselection only via dropdown.
Applied filters must display as text list within search bar, with ellipsis truncation when too long.

Actions: Search executes using current search value and filters and populates Search Results; selected criteria persist after Search. Clear Filters resets search bar, all filter fields, and search results table.
Linked stories GEM-35732/GEM-37159 contain downstream search results/selection/add behavior, so this story must at minimum return data/filtering compatible with those flows.
Comment history indicates prior conflict around Supplier single vs multi-select; latest description still states single select, so unresolved ambiguity must be clarified before final validation.
missingInformation: Final confirmed behavior of Supplier filter selection cardinality (single-select vs multi-select) is not conclusively resolved in comments.
Definition of "search bar" versus "Add-On Name" filter is inconsistent (possible dual-search removal mentioned in comments).
Whether typeahead suggestions are required for Add-On Name field in this story, and exact API contract for suggestions, is not explicitly specified.
Exact backend endpoint(s), request/response schemas, and validation/error response standards are not provided.
Whether max 200 characters should reject >200 with validation error, silently truncate, or block input is not specified for BE.
Case sensitivity, accent/diacritic handling, and partial-match rules for Add-On Name search are not specified.
Behavior when Supplier = All and Category/Add-On Name filters are also provided is not explicitly defined beyond catalog source selection.
Pagination, sorting, and result limits for returned search results are not specified in this ticket.
Authorization/error handling behavior for PV organizations (hidden option vs API forbidden) is not explicitly defined.
No explicit performance/non-functional requirements are provided (e.g., response time under infinite scroll or search).
ambiguities: Comment 2 suggests removing dual search and searching based on Add-On Name/Supplier/Category, but story still references search bar and Add-On Name filter; overlap is unclear.
Main table says Supplier is single select, while review comment discusses uncertainty and potential multi-select need.
Description says Add-On Name has no minimum chars, comment mentions one character to begin populating dropdown results—unclear if this applies to search bar suggestions only.
It is unclear whether "Searchable text field" implies server-side suggestion endpoint or only free text submitted on Search click.
Applied filters display in search bar field may conflict if search bar itself is also input for add-on search text.
risks: Incorrect org eligibility enforcement could expose catalog import to PV organizations or hide functionality from non-PV users.
Supplier source aggregation across organization locations may be incorrectly scoped to current context location, causing missing suppliers.
Inconsistent Supplier single/multi-select implementation between FE and BE may cause request contract mismatch.
All/default supplier behavior may incorrectly query supplier catalogs instead of master catalog, producing wrong results.
Category enum mismatches (label/casing/order) could break filtering and FE display assumptions.
Clear Filters may fail to reset backend query state, causing stale filtered results.
Typeahead/suggestion behavior ambiguity may lead to duplicate endpoints or non-functional UX expectations.
Large supplier lists with infinite scroll may cause performance or pagination defects.
Text search handling for special characters may cause query errors or injection/security concerns if not sanitized.
dependencies: GEM-37158 (FE - Product Category and Filters) for UI behavior and request wiring.
GEM-35732 and GEM-37159 for search results, selection, add confirmation, and toast integration.
GEM-37987 sub-task defining SPL_ADDON_TYPE attribute, likely required for category/filter mapping.
Organization/supplier master data services that provide loaded active electronic supplier locations.
Authorization/tenant context service to determine PV vs non-PV organization behavior.
Existing Catalog Import and Frames/Spectacle Lens filter behavior patterns referenced as baseline.
clarificationQuestions: Please confirm final Supplier filter behavior: single-select or multi-select?
Is there a separate top search bar input in this story, or should Add-On Name be the only free-text search input?
If typeahead suggestions are required, for which field(s) exactly (search bar, Add-On Name, both), and what is the minimum character threshold?
For Add-On Name max 200 chars, what should BE do when payload exceeds 200 (validation error vs truncate)?
Should Add-On Name matching be case-insensitive, and should special characters/diacritics be normalized?
When Supplier=All plus other filters are set, should filtering run over master catalog only, or merged supplier catalogs?
What is the expected API response when a PV organization attempts to access this category/filter endpoint (403, empty, hidden by FE only)?
Do category values use fixed backend enums? Please provide canonical enum keys and display labels.
Are there required pagination and sorting rules for supplier dropdown data and search results in this story?
Should inactive suppliers ever be returned if previously selected/stored in user state?
recommendedTestScenarios: Validate non-PV organization can access Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons category data path.
Validate PV organization cannot use catalog import endpoints for this category.
Validate Supplier list contains default All and loaded active electronic suppliers only, sorted A-Z.
Validate Supplier list behavior when no loaded suppliers exist (only All).
Validate Category filter supports defined values only and correct alphabetical order.
Validate Add-On Name accepts special characters and supports up to 200 characters.
Validate search execution uses combined criteria and returns filtered results.
Validate Clear Filters resets all criteria and empties/reset search results.
Validate persistence of selected filter values after Search.
Validate boundary and negative inputs (201 chars, invalid category, invalid supplier id).
Validate integration with linked search results story contract (fields/filters honored).
Validate regression of existing Spectacle Lens and Frames filter behaviors is unaffected.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that non-PV organizations can use Spectacle Lens Add-Ons category search
preconditions: At least one add-on record exists

steps.action: Call catalog import search endpoint for Product Category = Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons with Supplier=All
steps.expected: Request is accepted and returns successful response with add-on search results payload.

steps.action: Include Category and Add-On Name filters in the same request
steps.expected: Response reflects combined filtering without contract errors.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that PV organizations are blocked from catalog import add-ons access

steps.action: Call catalog import add-ons category/filter/search endpoint with valid payload
steps.expected: Access is denied or unavailable according to platform rule for PV orgs.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that supplier options return All first and active loaded electronic suppliers sorted alphabetically
preconditions: Non-PV org has multiple loaded supplier locations with mixed active/inactive and electronic/non-electronic statuses

steps.action: Request supplier filter options for Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons

steps.expected: Only active loaded electronic supplier locations are present, sorted by name A-Z.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that supplier options return only All when no loaded suppliers exist
preconditions: Non-PV org has zero loaded suppliers for eligible scope

steps.expected: Only All is returned; no supplier-specific options are included.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that category filter accepts only defined add-on categories
preconditions: Non-PV org and add-ons endpoint available

steps.action: Submit search with valid categories: Coatings, Finishing, Other, Surfacing, Tints
steps.expected: Request succeeds and applies category filtering.

steps.action: Submit search with an invalid category value
steps.expected: Request fails validation or ignores invalid value per API contract; no server error occurs.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Add-On Name supports up to 200 characters and special characters
preconditions: Non-PV org and add-ons endpoint available

steps.action: Submit search with Add-On Name containing 200 characters including special symbols
Submit search with Add-On Name containing 201 characters
steps.expected: Behavior follows defined validation handling (currently needs clarification); no unhandled error.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that search applies combined Supplier, Category, and Add-On Name criteria
preconditions: Dataset includes records across multiple suppliers/categories/add-on names

steps.action: Search with Supplier=All, Category=Coatings, Add-On Name partial term
steps.expected: Results match Coatings and Add-On Name criteria from master catalog scope.

steps.action: Search with specific Supplier and same other criteria
steps.expected: Results are constrained to selected supplier catalog(s) and still match other filters.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Clear Filters resets criteria and search results state
preconditions: A prior search has been executed with non-default filters and non-empty results

steps.expected: Search text, Supplier, Category, and Add-On Name criteria are reset to default/blank state.

steps.action: Observe results state after clear action
steps.expected: Search Results table is reset/cleared as specified.

regressionConsiderations: Ensure existing Catalog Import categories and filters (especially Spectacle Lens and Frames behaviors) remain unchanged.
Ensure supplier retrieval logic changes do not affect other ordering screens using supplier dropdowns.
Ensure org-level PV restrictions continue to apply consistently across all catalog import endpoints.
Ensure search result contracts consumed by GEM-35732/GEM-37159 are backward compatible where shared.
Ensure clear/search action handling does not regress persisted filter UI state behavior in FE integrations.
